title: Shalin Mantri (Eric advisee, ex-Uber/Google, Stanford CS) — 'trust has already been broken too many times'
summary: Shalin Mantri — Founder & CEO (ex-Uber, ex-Google, Stanford CS) and one of Eric's startup advisees — was a pre-reader of Incorruptible and applies its collapse-of-trust framework to the AI labs asking the public for an enormous amount of trust in a low-trust world.
blockquote: If given Neo's choice in The Matrix, I suspect many people, at this moment, might choose the blue pill. Not because they are irrational. Because trust has already been broken too many times.
attribution_title: Founder & CEO (ex-Uber, ex-Google, Stanford CS); Eric Ries startup advisee
